analysis.overall: The day featured a mix of smooth management, a rough afternoon dip following a site change, and an overnight stubborn high, though you still maintained solid time in range overall.

events.title: Site change and drop
events.description: After changing the insulin site and dealing with temporary offline status, glucose dropped quickly into the 40s over the next hour.

events.title: Overnight rise
events.description: Glucose began climbing steadily past 180 mg/dL, requiring a series of small correction boluses over a couple of hours to bring it back down.

events.title: Morning meal spike
events.description: Following breakfast, glucose shot up sharply with double-up arrows, peaking near 218 mg/dL before corrections brought it back into range.

events.title: Post-spike recovery
events.description: After the morning peak and subsequent corrections, glucose steadily coasted back down into a stable range by late morning.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on how new infusion sites absorb insulin immediately after a change to avoid sudden drops.
